Please through light in the matter. Question: We are running a 5 star hotel with bar which is against sharia. We need following clarification as per quran and sharia. 1. If we give bar area to outside the company o rent which is permissiable in sharia. 2. If we lease out the hotel completly with bar and will get yearly rent of a prperty. Wat will sharia says can we still commiting sin as per quran. 3.what is the solution for us in order to follow islamic principles to avoid bar permisses. 4.if a person is not taking any bar income but the place in hotel is run by the other partner what islamic sharia says . Please through light in the matter. Answer ID: 3730 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 371/349=L) (1,2) The first tow cases are unlawful since it is helping in sin (which is prohibited) as Allah says: تعاونوا علی البر والتقوی ولا تعاونوا علی الاثم والعدوان (3) The only solution to bar is that it is closed and something other is sold instead; since drinking wine is haram and it has been declared impure by the Quran. (4) If you do not take any thing from bar income then your income will be halal , but if you own the hotel and you gave it freely to someone knowing that he will sell wine there, then you will be sinful according to the verse referred above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
